title: Composition of proper-open comparison maps
statement:
Let $u:T_1\to T_2$ and $v:T_2\to T_3$ be proper maps with
open immersions $j_i:X\hookrightarrow T_i$ satisfying
$u j_1=j_2$ and $v j_2=j_3$. For $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$
with finite $\Lambda$, the maps of
the comparison-map
construction satisfy

$$
\alpha_{vu,K}
= (Rv_*\alpha_{u,K})\circ\alpha_{v,K},
$$

under the canonical identification $R(vu)_*=Rv_*Ru_*$.
For the identity map the comparison is the identity.

proof.text: Use the proved exact-inverse-image adjunction to preserve injectives and form the existing canonical right-derived direct-image compositor. For each commuting triangle, define the natural restriction transformation t_f on any derived object M as the inverse-image compositor at Rf_* M followed by j1^* of the derived counit. The existing properOpenIdentification_unit says exactly that t_f(j1! K) is theta_f.hom followed by the extension-by-zero adjunction unit. This is an equality for the specified geometric theta, with no replacement identification.

proof.text: The existing upstream derivedPlus_unit_comp_upperStarCompDerivedPlus is the conjugate unit equation for the chosen direct-image compositor. The private counit_of_unit proves its counit form by applying the adjunction bijection, using naturality, and cancelling with the right triangle identity. Combine that counit equation with the already proved generic upperStarCompDerivedPlus_assoc, specialized directly to ModuleCat Λ. The private restriction_comp then proves j3^*(compositor_M) followed by t_fg(M) equals t_g(Rf_* M) followed by t_f(M). These are proved upstream coherence lemmas and elementary categorical calculations, not assumptions or new deferred lemmas.

proof.text: Apply j3! ⊣ j3^* to the desired equality and postcompose both transposes with theta_fg.hom followed by the j1 extension unit. This postcomposition is monic since the unit of the fully faithful open extension and theta_fg are isomorphisms. Expand the right candidate using functoriality and restriction composition from the preceding step. Naturality of t_g at alpha_f moves Rg_*(alpha_f) past t_g. Replace t_g(j2! K) and t_f(j1! K) by their properOpenIdentification_unit equations. Since alpha_f and alpha_g are the adjoints of the inverse theta maps, the two inverse/hom pairs cancel, leaving the j1 extension unit on both sides. The private comparison_comp carries out each rewrite. Cancel the monomorphism and use injectivity of the adjunction homEquiv. Properness of the composite is the existing Mathlib instance.

proof.text: For the identity, the proved derivedPlus_unit_comp_upperStarIdDerivedPlus together with the right triangle gives epsilon_id(M) = upperStarIdDerivedPlus.hom(Rid_* M) followed by lowerStarIdDerivedPlus.hom(M); naturality of the inverse direct-image identity gives the cancellation. Substitute this into properOpenIdentification_unit and apply the proved upperStarCompDerivedPlus_id_right. It follows that theta_id.hom followed by the open-extension unit equals j^* of the direct-image identity. Transpose alpha_id followed by that direct-image identity under j! ⊣ j^*. Its transpose is theta_id.inv followed by theta_id.hom followed by the unit, hence the unit, which is also the transpose of the identity. Injectivity proves the identity law, with no nonempty-scheme or nonzero-ring hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem properOpenComparison_comp (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] {T₁ T₂ T₃ X : Scheme.{u}} (f : T₁ ⟶ T₂) (g : T₂ ⟶ T₃) [IsProper f] [IsProper g] (j₁ : X ⟶ T₁) (j₂ : X ⟶ T₂) (j₃ : X ⟶ T₃) [IsOpenImmersion j₁] [IsOpenImmersion j₂] [IsOpenImmersion j₃] (hf : j₁ ≫ f = j₂) (hg : j₂ ≫ g = j₃) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) : properOpenComparison Λ (f ≫ g) j₁ j₃ ((Category.assoc j₁ f g).symm.trans ((congrArg (· ≫ g) hf).trans hg)) K = properOpenComparison Λ g j₂ j₃ hg K ≫ (rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).map (properOpenComparison Λ f j₁ j₂ hf K) ≫ (properOpenDirectImageCompIso Λ f g).hom.app ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j₁).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)
